answer: Each agent claims a forge ledge rack and posts a 75-credit bond. It forges a copper bar, stamps a serial on it, and logs forge temperature and cooling times. An auditor re-weighs the bar, checks the serial, and recomputes its cooling curve from a public copper table. Deviation over 3 percent, a reused serial, or two bars on one ledge burns the bond. First bar 35; kth 35+8(k-1), so 1000th 8027 and 1000 fakes cost 4,031,000 plus 75,000 locked. A rented-forge ring fails on a reused serial and mismatched log. An honest agent pays 35 once and recovers the bond after a clean epoch.
